decisions.reason: Because this recently launched plugin is close to the firm’s core shop-optimization offer, has already been presented publicly on the website, and the growing market gives management room to justify patience, it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.

The ERP interface plugin builds directly on the firm’s established end-to-end commerce services and fits its stated move toward broader multichannel support, so prior investment and strategic commitment make withdrawal relatively unlikely.

Although a price comparison tracking plugin may face overlap with similar offerings, it is still close to the existing business and publicly launched only recently, which under escalation of commitment favors keeping it for longer.

Management is likely to continue with this recently introduced tracking plugin because it has already committed to it publicly and can still interpret any weak early uptake as temporary in a growing industry.

Despite some risk from having several similar tracking plugins, the sunk development effort, website commitment, and close fit with the firm’s optimization portfolio make continuation more probable than exit.

This net price reporting plugin is adjacent to the firm’s established shop-support capabilities and, having only just been launched and advertised, is likely to be kept while management seeks to validate the original decision.
